instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the Signal conversations my client printed into my own records", and give it self_id (The identity Signal knows this account by.); conversations (What the person's Signal client printed: a list of conversations, each { id, name?, type?, messages: [{ id?, timestamp (epoch milliseconds), from, body?, editedTimestamp?, type?).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-signal-messages and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Keeps the conversations a Signal client on your computer printed (signal-cli output, handed in as conversations) as conversations in your records, with who the account is (self_id).
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list, records:write).
